title: Roofing and Cladding Products
metaDescription: Long run steel, corrugate, Roofdeck, weatherboard, clear roof lighting, spouting and flashings manufactured in Christchurch by Roofline Canterbury.
intro: Roofline manufactures one of the largest product ranges of any roofing manufacturer in New Zealand, using well-known suppliers such as ColorCote and Zincalume. Everything is rolled or folded to length in our own Christchurch factory.

sections.heading: Roofing
bullets: Long Run Steel in corrugate and Roofdeck profiles
Corrugate: the classic profile, through-fixed, from about 8 degrees pitch
Roofdeck: trapezoidal long-run with stronger spanning, from about 3 degrees
0.40mm and 0.55mm gauges in ColorCote finishes and Zincalume
Natural Roof Lighting: clear polycarbonate sheets matched to your profile

sections.heading: Spouting and guttering
bullets: New Fascia and Quad Spouting System in continuous lengths
Gutters, fascias and 80mm round downpipes in ColorCote finishes
Colour-matched brackets and fittings

sections.heading: Flashings
bullets: Roof flashings: ridge, barge, hip and valley, folded to order
Wall cladding flashings: corners, sills, joiners and trims
Fast factory turnaround, colour-matched to your roofing

sections.heading: Colours and warranty
body: The ColorCote colour range covers the popular New Zealand roof colours, with manufacturer warranties on coated steel products. Our team can help you match an existing roof or a colour scheme.

title: Our Services
metaDescription: New roofing, re-roofing, commercial roofing, wall cladding, spouting, flashings, asbestos removal and free measure and quote from Roofline Canterbury.
intro: From asbestos removal to roofing supplies, no matter how big or small your project, our service stays the same. You deal with the same person and receive the same care, attention and prompt service every time.

sections.heading: What we do
bullets: New Roofing for new builds and renovations
ReRoofing, including safe asbestos cement removal where needed
Commercial Roofing for large projects
Wall Cladding supply and installation
New Spouting and guttering systems
Free measure and quote
Price your plans: send drawings and we measure and price from them

sections.heading: Supply only or supply and install
body: Buy manufactured product supply-only for your own builder, or use our own installation team for a complete supply and install job. Either way the product is made in our Christchurch factory with fast turnaround.

title: Common Questions
metaDescription: Answers to common questions about Roofline Canterbury products, services, plan pricing and re-roofing.
intro: Quick answers to the questions customers ask most. The Smart Assistant can answer these and price your project in conversation.

sections.heading: Products and ordering
bullets: We manufacture ourselves in Christchurch, so turnaround is fast
Supply-only for builders, or full supply and install
Flashings folded to order and colour-matched
ColorCote and Zincalume ranges, 0.40g and 0.55g gauges

sections.heading: Pricing your project
body: Use the free tools on this website for an instant indicative estimate, send your plans through the contact form for full plan pricing, or ask the Smart Assistant for a conversational estimate.
